[[File:TheCanyon.jpg|230px|thumb|The Canyon, home of the Corsair thug faction]]

'''The Canyon''' was an area of the [[Karthakk system]], home of the [[Canyon Corsairs|Corsair]] thug faction, a mercilessness band of hooligans promising to wreak havoc on any passing civilian or vessel. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was not uncommon to see a Corsair looting its latest victim and speeding off to find another.<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Canyon was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
